description: Waze 5.24.5.0 (ARM64). Six independent options: selectable map themes; selectable report icon packs; detailed report icons at normal sizes; local rank badge selector; unlock driver moods; Android Auto setup. Google Maps icons are now the default when no icon pack has been selected. Saved choices are retained. Traffic-report icons now use red backgrounds with white artwork. Themes, icon packs and Android Auto setup are now separate patches, making six independent options in one bundle.
